summary: Aluminium angle bracket bolted to a base plate with two M6 through bolts
assumptions: Sizes from the brief; bolt grip = plate 10 + foot 8 = 18.

subassemblies.name: Bracket assembly
subassemblies.description: The base plate with the bracket bolted on top.

parts.name: Base plate
parts.description: Aluminium base plate 120 x 80 x 10 mm with two Ø6.6 holes 40 mm apart for the bracket bolts and four Ø9 corner holes.

parts.name: Angle bracket
parts.description: Aluminium angle bracket: foot 60 x 40 x 8 with two Ø6.6 holes 40 apart, upright 8 thick and 50 high with a Ø8.4 hole 40 mm up.

parts.name: Hex bolt M6x30
parts.description: ISO 4017 hex bolt M6 x 30 through the bracket foot and the plate.

parts.name: Washer M6
parts.description: ISO 7089 washer M6, one under each bolt head and one under each nut.

parts.name: Hex nut M6
parts.description: ISO 4032 hex nut M6 under the plate.
